target: call_sol.sh — the OpenRouter request declares the findings schema in ITS wire shape (response_format), so spec 016's optimisation survives the new transport
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e '.response_format.json_schema.schema.properties.findings.items.required | index("location") != null' "$D"
